thank you for writing to the desk.

We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of a lost crate during your companion animal journey and the distress this caused for you and your animal.

Our records should be reviewed against the details you provided, and the matter will be handled through the usual claims process. <<FACT F118>> Please include any available travel documents, crate identifiers, and a clear account of when the item was last seen so the file can be assessed without delay. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is committed to reviewing each report carefully and to communicating clearly as the claim moves forward.

If the crate cannot be located through the airport and baggage channels, the matter may qualify for standard compensation under Aurelia Skyways policy. <<FACT F112>> We recommend keeping copies of all receipts related to the crate and any temporary animal care arrangements, as these documents often help support the review. When the case is complete, you will receive a written outcome and any approved payment will be issued through the normal claims route.

For future travel, our team encourages passengers to confirm crate labels, contact details, and animal documentation before departure and again at handover. The Companion Animal Travel Desk also reminds handlers to use calm, humane methods at every stage, because animal welfare remains central to our service.

We regret the disruption this incident has caused and appreciate the opportunity to address it. Please continue to share any additional information that may help us complete the review. Companion Animal Travel Desk
